scope: Actual final MP4 key-point/trophy/ending pixel and timing audit. Four non-Tokyo complete-point and trophy sequences use unchanged-content evidence to reuse the earlier actual-MP4 dense visual review; 17 native frames were freshly extracted from and visually inspected in the final MP4.

fresh_final_movie_inspection.method: Extracted 17 actual MP4 frames with ffmpeg at the film times below; visually opened all at original 1080x1440 resolution. These are spotchecks, not a second complete 3fps/5fps resampling.
findings: Shanghai service toss and net handshake present; Monte Carlo serve and handshake present; Basel semi-final serve and handshake present.
Basel final serve, final-point result posture, net handshake and final arms-up celebration present at the corresponding times.
Fresh trophy frames show receiving cup, securing both handles, raising it, overhead hold and actual gold-confetti podium shot. Changing cup/hand positions and confetti are live action.
Main player face is clear of subtitle typography in inspected handshake/celebration/raised-cup frames. During raising the cup naturally occludes the face.
Match and trophy samples fill the 3:4 frame and have no bottom video handle. Last frame is clean brand outro, not an advertisement or black tail.
No new visual discrepancy was observed in these 17 actual final-movie spotchecks.

limited_reuse.historical_actual_visual_work: 366 point/trophy samples at 3fps/5fps + 14 ending samples across 21 contact sheets, plus 20 native PNGs, actually viewed on old movie 26f94025…; report and evidence remain bound to that movie.
limited_reuse.what_is_reused: Non-Tokyo key-point temporal completeness, source-to-film offsets, trophy handover/raising/confetti continuity, subtitle/brand placement and clean ending observations. Their retained composition boundaries remain applicable.
limited_reuse.what_is_not_claimed: The final movie was not again fully viewed at 3fps/5fps for all 366+14 samples; the historical review is not relabelled with a new SHA. Tokyo changes are excluded from this review reuse.

evidence.method: decode both actual movies; compare every non-Tokyo frame at540x720, and every corresponding native700x125 brandregion; SSIM statistics are evidence for unchanged-content review reuse, not standalone finalQC; actual changedTokyoframes independently inspected

limited_reuse.bridge_assessment: Parent-provided actual-movie delta proof was read and checked for matching old/new identities and sole Tokyo inset timing delta. Identical assets, ASS, sources/audio timeline and high-similarity every non-Tokyo frame support the explicitly limited reuse; this is not a byte-identical-video or independent full-film-QC claim.
